message.reasoning:
Key issues: Kourou latitude stated as 45.05°N (actually ~5.2°N) — clear technical error. Inclination 87.79° at 600 km — correct for SSO (~97.8° actually; at 600 km SSO inclination is ~97.8°, not 87.79°!). Wait: SSO inclination at 600 km is ~97.8° retrograde. 87.79° is prograde and cannot be sun-synchronous (needs retrograde precession). The plot shows inclination rising from 96.5 to 99.5 — so 87.79° contradicts their own plot. Major error. Also "retrograde" with i=87.79° inconsistent. RAAN 27.33° "indicates location of launch facility" — wrong concept. Wikipedia used as source [6] — prohibited. Mean duration "almost twenty minutes" but 580 s ≈ 9.7 min — error. Also "very high altitude would yield low resolution images which is also desirable" — error. Drag sail described as passive but earlier says uncontrolled descent; fine. No STK files mentioned in appendix? Screenshots present. Users: operator (University of Tasmania? no—operator Australian facilities) and customers (marine scientists) — partially addressed. Mission duration 5 years, EOL drag sail — addressed. Ground control frequency — addressed with STK access report.

C1: rationale good, users partially (operator/customers vague), single spacecraft justified. Adequate-to-accomplished; some referencing incomplete. Mark 7? Users not clearly identified (operator/customers). I'd say 6.

C2: comprehensive but with major technical errors (inclination, latitude, contact duration claim, RAAN). Adequate: 5.

C3: conclusion generic-ish but summarizes; 6.

C4: structure good, figures labelled somewhat, references are bare URLs, Wikipedia used. Adequate: 5.
